generators.episode_check_r116.py:
"""IS-only episode concentration of squeeze_breakout's top breadth cells (the
grid's own frame, net basis, long leg). For each cell: IS trades, distinct
months, the largest month's share, and the cell's IS Sharpe with that month
removed - a regime-clustered edge shows as a large share and a collapse when
its month leaves. Holdout never read (rc.in_sample). Prints and writes JSON."""
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(r"C:\Users\jeetm\Github\stock-picks-app")
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "scripts"))
import roster_core as rc  # noqa: E402
import breadth_step1_grid as g  # noqa: E402

CELLS = [("gold_silver_ratio", "ge", 10.1703), ("vix_value", "ge", 31.37),
         ("short_interest_observations", "ge", 65.0), ("po3_accum_range_pct", "ge", 0.1427)]
EXIT = "class_time_stop"
keys = [k for k, _, _ in CELLS]
m, _ = g.build_frame("squeeze_breakout", None, keys, basis="net", leg="long")
IS = rc.in_sample(m)
out = []
base = IS[IS.exit_method == EXIT]
rb = rc._sharpe(base["pnl_pct"].values, base["hold_days"], min_n=10)
print(f"production base {EXIT}: IS n {len(base)} sharpe {rb['sharpe']}")
for key, op, lev in CELLS:
    sub = IS[(IS.exit_method == EXIT) & g._cell_mask(IS, key, op, lev) & IS[key].notna()].copy()
    sub["month"] = [str(d)[:7] for d in sub["entry_date"]]
    vc = sub["month"].value_counts()
    top_m, top_n = vc.index[0], int(vc.iloc[0])
    r_all = rc._sharpe(sub["pnl_pct"].values, sub["hold_days"], min_n=10)
    rest = sub[sub["month"] != top_m]
    r_rest = rc._sharpe(rest["pnl_pct"].values, rest["hold_days"], min_n=10)
    top3 = [(m_, int(n_)) for m_, n_ in vc.head(3).items()]
    rec = {"cell": f"{key} {op} {lev}", "exit": EXIT, "is_n": int(len(sub)),
           "months": int(vc.size), "top_months": top3,
           "top_month_share": round(top_n / len(sub), 3),
           "is_sharpe": r_all["sharpe"] if r_all else None,
           "is_sharpe_without_top_month": r_rest["sharpe"] if r_rest else None,
           "n_without_top_month": int(len(rest))}
    out.append(rec)
    print(json.dumps(rec))
Path(sys.argv[1]).write_text(json.dumps({"production_base": {"exit": EXIT, "is_n": int(len(base)),
                                                             "is_sharpe": rb["sharpe"]},
                                         "cells": out}, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
